text.arabic_uthmani: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ ۙ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌۭ

baseline.text: Allah, inanıp iyi işler yapanlara bağışlanma ve büyük bir ödül vadetmiştir.

findings.text: Allah'ın vaadi, çalışanı kayba karşı örten ve emeğinin karşılığını güvenceye alan bir gelecek açar.
Büyük ödül yalnız miktar değil, iyilik yapanın tanınmış saygınlığının yükseltilmesidir.

activation_trace.role: A spoken promise opens hope in what is pledged and establishes the assurance that drives the model.
Heart-settling assent makes belief an active reception of the promise rather than a bare group label.
Intentional doing supplies the enacted side of the recipient condition.
Rectification opposed to corruption gives the deeds a repair-oriented direction.
Covering a fault while protecting its bearer from the fault's effect supplies the defensive half of the outcome.
A return, wage, or benefit for work supplies the positive and answerable half of the outcome.
Magnitude and force prevent the reward from reading as a merely token return.

changed_reading.after: A reliable two-part settlement for trusting, rectifying action: damaging liability is covered and its bearer protected, while a positively magnified return is granted.
changed_reading.before: A general assurance that good people will receive good things.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "God promised those who believed and did rectifying deeds; for them..." joins a named promisor, a two-part recipient condition, and the paired result "forgiveness and a great reward."
baseline_models.mechanism: The promise opens settled expectation; belief supplies trusting assent, deliberate work repairs corruption, forgiveness covers fault and protects from its consequence, and reward returns benefit for work. "Great" enlarges the force of the positive return, so the result is both protective and additive rather than a single undifferentiated good.

activation_trace.role: The divine pledge remains the assured speech whose relational setting is being sharpened.
Completion without deficiency supplies the demanded quality of human fulfillment.
A binding, ratified undertaking turns the surrounding commands into a covenant frame for the promise.

changed_reading.after: God's reliable promise anchors a reciprocal covenant culture in which belief and rectifying work include making human commitments whole.
changed_reading.before: God's promise is a one-way assurance to a pre-existing class.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first contextual address commands believers to fulfill binding contracts completely. This places God's promise inside a covenantal ecology: the promised recipients are not merely waiting on reliable speech but are being formed into people whose own commitments become reliable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete fulfillment and binding contracts; I supply the reciprocal arrow that God's reliable promise forms recipients into reliable promise-keepers. A live alternative is that 5:1 is only a legal preface and does not characterize the logic of 5:9.
structural_cues: 5:1 addresses the same believing category and immediately orders it to fulfill contracts.
The window begins with human covenant performance before 5:9 states divine promise performance.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption is the focus anchor whose practical content the hostile setting exposes.
Hatred and enmity supply the pressure under which rectification must remain operative.
Mutual assistance makes good or transgression a socially amplified practice rather than an isolated act.
Expansive good and obedience name the cooperative direction that counters hostile excess.
The return of hatred immediately before the focus makes hostility a repeated stress test, not an incidental example.
Equity supplies the public standard by which a deed resists corruption.
Repeated just judgment turns non-bias under hostility into an enacted form of rectification.

changed_reading.after: "Rectifying deeds" centrally include public practices that keep hatred from reproducing corruption: fair witness, measured judgment, and cooperation in expansive good.
changed_reading.before: "Righteous deeds" is an open list of privately meritorious acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated hostility sequence tests rectifying action at the point where grievance normally bends conduct. Cooperative good and impartial judgment under enmity give "the rectifying deeds" public and relational content: they repair a field of antagonism by blocking retaliatory excess and preserving fair measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two hostility tests, cooperation, equity, and repeated justice; I infer that these are privileged diagnostics of "rectifying deeds." They may instead be prominent examples without exhausting that phrase.
structural_cues: 5:2 and 5:8 repeat the sequence hatred -> prohibition of excess or injustice -> commanded counterpractice.
5:8 stands immediately before the focus and ends with divine knowledge of what the addressees do.

activation_trace.role: The work-return branch supplies the focus's remuneration register.
A concrete contractual due makes the nearby reward vocabulary materially payable rather than vague praise.
Covering or blocking truth supplies the rupture that detaches work from its promised yield.
Assenting faith appears both in the believing category and as the explicitly rejected condition, binding identity to response.
Falling and collapse provide the mechanism by which performed work can cease to bear a final return.
Intentional work is the very thing whose outcome collapses, preventing an automatic act-to-credit model.

changed_reading.after: The promised return is covenantally answerable but not mechanically banked: work bears enduring yield only as the enacted side of faith.
changed_reading.before: Each good act deposits an independently secure unit of reward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same local vocabulary joins concrete dues, faith, work, collapse, and final loss. Reward therefore acquires the feel of an owed return without becoming an automatically banked unit: the packet's negative chain shows work losing its yield when severed from faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the homologous reward, faith, work, collapse, and loss terms; I infer that faith preserves the eschatological yield of work rather than merely opening a separate eligibility box. The alternative is that the marriage due and final loss are locally distinct uses whose proximity should not be systematized.
structural_cues: 5:5 moves from paying "their dues" to the chain rejection of faith -> collapsed work -> final loss.
5:9 keeps faith and work conjoined before naming reward.

activation_trace.role: Protection from the effect of fault is the focus anchor expanded by the accommodation sequences.
Compulsion and necessity supply the constrained condition under which rigid application would itself damage.
An empty belly makes the necessity bodily and concrete rather than an abstract excuse.
Inclination away from straight intent distinguishes compelled survival from chosen deviation.
The repeated forgiveness branch explicitly closes the necessity exception with protection from culpable effect.
Tender mercy supplies the governing disposition behind the exception.
Removal of contamination makes restoration, not mere rule satisfaction, the positive purpose of accommodation.
Rejected constriction identifies crushing burden as what the divine arrangement is designed to avoid.
Bringing favor to completion makes accommodation a means of wholeness rather than a deficient substitute.

changed_reading.after: Forgiveness belongs to a protective economy that reads constraint and intent, removes crushing burden, and restores agents to a whole rectifying relation.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness covers a fault only after an otherwise uniform demand has been breached.

context_deltas.mechanism: Necessity, empty hunger, and absence of willful deviation produce a merciful exception; bodily constraints later produce alternate purification while the stated purpose rejects hardship and completes favor. These sequences change forgiveness from post hoc concealment into a protective governance that keeps vulnerable agents within a rectifying relation without crushing them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constrained bodies, non-deviant intent, forgiveness, rejected hardship, purification, and completion; I infer one protective-restorative logic across them. A live alternative keeps legal accommodation and eschatological forgiveness as parallel but distinct mechanisms.
structural_cues: 5:3 conditions its exception on necessity without intentional inclination to sin and closes with forgiving mercy.
5:6 supplies alternate means under illness, travel, or lack of water, then states no hardship but purification and completion as purposes.

activation_trace.role: The assured pledge is the compact form that the later conditional undertaking unfolds.
Protection from fault's consequence corresponds to the later removal of bad effects.
Return for work corresponds to the later positive admission and continuing provision.
A confirmed covenant supplies the explicit juridical frame for the conditional exchange.
Giving wealth or work for a returned recompense makes present action an entrusted advance rather than a purchase of divine control.
Doing what is beautiful qualifies the advance and links it to the focus's rectifying action.
Entry turns positive reward into admission to a domain, not merely receipt of an object.
A garden enclosed by growth supplies the concrete domain of the positive undertaking.
Flowing movement gives the promised domain an ongoing rather than static abundance.

changed_reading.after: The focus compresses a covenant discharge: faithful rectifying action is entrusted forward, damaging liabilities are removed, and recipients are admitted into an ongoing positive domain.
changed_reading.before: The focus gives an abstract promise with unspecified relation between its two benefits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The formal pact of 5:12 sets a conditional cluster of worship, giving, belief, support, and a good loan against two divine undertakings: removal of bad effects and entry into flowing gardens. That sequence expands 5:9's compact forgiveness-plus-reward formula into a covenant discharge with both liability release and positive admission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a confirmed pact, a return-bearing good loan, expiation, and garden entry; I identify the latter pair with 5:9's forgiveness and reward and treat the loan as one mechanism for the work-return relation. Alternatively, the loan may be only one deed in the list rather than a master image for the whole promise.
structural_cues: 5:12 uses an explicit if-clause followed by emphatic first-person divine commitments to remove bad effects and admit the addressees to gardens.
Its two promised consequences preserve the same negative-release plus positive-gain order as 5:9.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering of fault supplies the divine benefit whose social analogue is activated.
Repair opposed to corruption anchors pardon as a possible kind of rectifying action.
Undoing what was bound supplies the relational rupture that calls for repair.
The confirmed covenant identifies the broken object and intensifies the injury.
Loss of the heart's softness shows the self-reinforcing damage produced by breach.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies the first active interruption of the damage cycle.
A beautiful turning away from the offense supplies a page-turning mode of continued relation.
Heart-abiding love marks the divine valuation of the reparative response.
Beautiful action classifies pardon and page-turning as an active good, not passive indifference.

changed_reading.after: Forgiveness is also a pattern righteous agents can enact: lucidly acknowledge breach, then refuse to let punishment and hardened reciprocity reproduce the damage.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is only a benefit that righteous agents receive from God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covenant breach produces hardening, displacement, and forgetting, yet the response commanded is to leave punishment and turn a clean page; that response is followed by divine love for doers of good. The promised forgiveness is thus not only a vertical benefit received after rectifying deeds: its logic can itself be enacted as a rectifying deed that interrupts the breach-to-hardness cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rupture, hardening, pardon, page-turning, and love for beautiful actors; I infer that recipients mirror the logic of promised forgiveness by practicing it. The alternative is that the imperatives are situational strategy and should not be folded into the general category of rectifying deeds.
structural_cues: 5:13 moves from broken covenant and hard hearts to paired imperatives of pardon and overlooking, then to divine love for doers of good.
The response does not deny the breach; it changes what the knower of the breach does next.

activation_trace.role: Benefit returning on action is the focus anchor re-read as an experienced trajectory.
Magnitude permits the reward to encompass an entire transformed mode of passage.
Gentle indication toward path and truth supplies the directing force of the return.
Following behind supplies the recipient's responsive movement rather than passive receipt.
Sought abundant approval identifies the orientation that the follower pursues.
Extended traversable ways make the positive outcome spatial and processual.
Freedom from damage names the condition into which those ways lead.
Movement out of an enclosing state supplies the transition rather than a static verdict.
Illumination supplies the new perceptual field reached by the guided exit.

changed_reading.after: Great reward can already take process form as guided passage into safer, clearer, and straighter participation, while remaining open to later fulfillment.
changed_reading.before: Great reward is only a deferred object paid after the qualifying life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following what pleases God triggers gentle guidance through ways of wholeness, an exit from darkness into light, and orientation to a straight path. This activates a process reading of great reward: the positive return can be participation in guided transformation, not only a deferred item handed over after action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, guidance, traversable ways, safe wholeness, exit, and light; I treat this transformation as one realization of the focus's returning benefit. A live alternative reserves "reward" for a later grant and treats guidance only as an antecedent aid.
structural_cues: 5:16 is a causal movement chain: following approval -> guided ways of peace -> exit from darkness -> light -> straight path.
The sequence describes an ongoing state change rather than a single transferred object.

activation_trace.role: The reliable pledge remains firm even as entitlement-based explanations of it are reduced.
The wage-like return is the branch being qualified so it does not become a claim of control over the promisor.
Claimed heart-abiding belovedness supplies the status assertion that the context refuses to treat as immunity.
Painful punishment prevents claimed intimacy from functioning as automatic exemption.
Actual fault supplies the accountability that status language cannot erase by itself.
Forgiveness remains an active protection granted by God rather than an inherited possession.
Will directed to an outcome preserves divine agency within both forgiveness and punishment.
Sovereignty supplies the non-possessable authority from which the promise proceeds.

changed_reading.after: The promise is dependable without becoming leverage: its recipients are named by lived trust and rectifying action, while forgiveness and reward remain acts of the sovereign promisor.
changed_reading.before: The reward is an entitlement possessed by anyone who can claim favored identity or enough credited work.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claim to inherited beloved status is answered by created human parity, liability for sins, and God's active freedom to forgive or punish. This weakens any reading of reward-language as leverage over God: the promise is reliable because God makes it, but its named class is relationally enacted through belief and work, not possessed through ancestry or self-ascribed intimacy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected beloved-status immunity, sin, forgiveness, punishment, will, and sovereignty; I use that contrast to qualify the wage branch in 5:9. The alternative is narrower: 5:18 may rebut only one communal boast without addressing the conceptual force of reward.
structural_cues: 5:18 directly answers the claim "we are God's children and beloved" with punishment for sins and the paired freedom to forgive or punish.
The focus names belief and action rather than lineage, communal title, or asserted intimacy.

activation_trace.role: The assured future is the focus anchor tested by the later offered-but-unentered destination.
Settled trust supplies the inward capacity to move toward what is promised.
Intentional action supplies the outward movement paired with trust.
Crossing into an interior turns reception of the written gift into a threshold action.
An established determination supplies the offered future before the recipients perform the entry.
Returning away from the destination supplies the reversal that can refuse an established offer.
Presenting the back and withdrawing makes the reversal bodily and directional.
Turning a thing from its face converts promised approach into inverted movement.
Loss names the consequence of self-reversing away from the written destination.
The gate supplies a concrete decision boundary at which confidence becomes action.
Reliant trust supplies the posture for crossing without pretending to control the result.
The explicit believer condition identifies secure trust with the entering alternative.
Negated entry states the refusal of threshold action in the same spatial terms.
Sitting back from action provides the exact counterimage to belief joined with intentional work.

changed_reading.after: Trust is readiness to cross the offered threshold, and rectifying work is the movement by which recipients inhabit a future God has promised rather than remain seated outside it.
changed_reading.before: Trust in the promise means waiting for God to deliver while action merely proves worthiness.

context_deltas.mechanism: A land already written for the people still demands entry; turning back converts the trajectory into loss. The believing alternative trusts, crosses the gate, and expects overcoming, while refusal culminates in sitting back from action. This makes the focus's conjunction of belief and work kinetic: promise supplies a real offered future, but trusting action is movement into it rather than a price that manufactures it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an established gift, a gate, trust, entry, reversal, loss, and sitting back; I infer that 5:9's belief-plus-work relation is participation in a promised future, not payment that creates it. The live alternative treats the land episode as a historical warning whose movement logic should not govern every promise.
structural_cues: 5:21 combines a destination already written by God with the imperative to enter and the warning that reversal produces loss.
5:23 joins gate-crossing, reliance on God, and the explicit condition "if you are believers"; 5:24 answers with permanent refusal and sitting.

remaining_uncertainties: The packet sustains both wage-like answerability and sovereign gift; it does not collapse their tension into a single economic model.
Justice, pardon, and gate-crossing may define privileged forms of rectifying work or may remain strong examples without exhausting the category.
The splint and annual-horizon readings are branch-anchored but form-distant material analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.
strongest_changes: The opening covenant commands make God's promise form promise-keepers rather than passive beneficiaries.
Repeated hostility tests give rectifying deeds concrete social content as justice and cooperation that resist retaliatory corruption.
The work-collapse sequence blocks an automatic credit ledger, while 5:12 preserves a covenantal return with liability release and positive admission.
The written-land and gate sequence makes belief plus work a kinetic participation in an offered future: trust enters, while refusal sits outside.
summary.what_was_special: The compact focus formula became a hinge between two contextual mechanisms: legal and social covenant practice before it, and covenant breach, pardon, guidance, and failed entry after it. The most productive surprise was that forgiveness and reward repeatedly behaved as restoration and participation, not merely cancellation plus payment.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption supplies the damaged-to-restored axis.
A protective covering supplies the dressing or shelter around what is damaged.
Setting a broken limb, even with residual crookedness, supplies the unusual restorative image for reward.
Hard bone makes the splint image materially coherent and gives "great" a cross-domain load-bearing resonance.
Removal of contamination adds cleaning to the covering-and-setting sequence.
Erasure of a trace supplies the reduction of lingering damage without claiming that all history disappears.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pair behaves like dressing and splinting: damage is covered, contamination and traces are reduced, and a fractured agent is restored to load-bearing life even if healing has a history.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness cancels liability and reward pays compensation as two externally assigned results.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant splinting branch of "reward" rather than its ordinary remuneration branch. It remains anchored in the focus's coordinated repair, covering, reward, and greatness roots, and context adds purification and erasure. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for restorative effect, not as the lexical gloss of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places rectifying deeds, protective covering, reward, and greatness in one causal result; the reward root includes a branch for setting a broken limb even when it heals with some crookedness.

activation_trace.role: An appointment bounded by time or place supplies a horizon at which a promise is met.
The split root's annual cycle supplies the exploratory image of promise unfolding through measured duration.
Long duration supplies the refusers' attempted conversion of a present threshold into permanent deferral.
Stillness and continuance reinforce refusal as duration without progress.
The number four supplies the counted structure of the forty-year interval.
The year branch makes the interval an explicitly measured temporal consequence.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, promise is a reliable temporal horizon: action can enter its appointed future, while refusal can turn the route toward it into measured delay and stationary duration.
changed_reading.before: A reliable promise implies an immediate, static transfer once its beneficiaries are named.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the focus root's appointment branch and its split mapping to annual flow with the later forty-year delay. It remains anchored in "promised" and in the packet's refusal-duration sequence. Downstream prose should call it a temporal architecture activated by branch proximity, not derive the normal meaning of "promised" from the remote annual branch.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's promise inventory includes a time-bounded appointment, while the same supplied split mapping reaches the annual cycle; later refusal converts entry into prolonged duration.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Promise opens expectation and covering secures the worker.** `و ع د B001` is a spoken promise opening expectation, `غ ف ر B001` protective covering, and `ء ج ر B001` recompense for work. The sequence belief–work–covering–wage resembles a labor relation. I infer that the promise authorizes sustained work by protecting against loss and assuring recompense.
2. **Great reward is social standing as well as magnitude.** `ع ظ م B010` gives social honor/standing, activated by the surah's recurrent public witness and truthful testimony. I infer that the reward restores the worker's acknowledged standing, so “great” can name elevated status rather than quantity alone.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A promise opens a protected future.** Fixed **و ع د / B001** (“a spoken promise that opens expectation”) gives the sentence temporal force, while fixed **غ ف ر / B001** (“protective covering”) makes forgiveness a sheltering outcome. Around it, 5:7 binds speech to obedience, 5:8 guards justice, 5:11 recalls intercepted harm, and 5:12 states a conditional covenant. I infer that faithful action moves into the future opened by the promise and under its covering. The compact ayah reads as the positive horizon of a covenantal sequence, not an isolated reward notice.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:12’s conditional covenant and 5:13’s breach made the promise read less as isolated reward and more as the protected future of maintained obligation.

words.gloss_range: perfect-form promise verb opening the ayah and governing both recipients and promised content
words.prose: {{ar:وَعَدَ}} ({{tr:waʿada}}) opens as a perfect-form promise, making the promised outcome sound settled rather than merely pending. The root can carry promise or threat, but the named subject and the reward clause narrow it here to binding promise. The verb also launches the ayah's full architecture: recipient group, then fronted allocation, then the two promised goods. Its opening conjunction keeps this declaration attached to the command-and-awareness frame of 5:8, so the ayah moves from watched moral action into certified outcome. The same promise-agent-recipient sequence is formulaically close to 48:29.
words.root_gloss_range: promise, threat, appointment, and expected outcome; locally the named divine subject and reward content select the positive promise branch

topics.headline: settled promise selected from broader polarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening verb presents the reward as a settled promise while the broader promise-threat root is locally narrowed by the reward context.
topics.reason: The perfect active verb and the following named subject support a settled declaration, while V4 branch evidence keeps the root's threat branch as background rather than the local sense.

topics.headline: promise-to-allocation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word is not an isolated pledge; it starts a compact sequence from promise to recipients to allocated reward.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the verb its recipient object and content clause, while the CRITICAL boundary and formula rows explain why the opening conjunction and promise frame matter for the ayah's movement.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in nominative subject position as the explicit promiser
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is the explicit nominative subject after the promise verb. The verb already carries a recoverable singular subject, so the named subject makes the promiser overt before the recipients and content unfold. The proper-name form keeps the source fully specified, not anonymous or merely mediated. The derivational pressure around worship and overwhelming authority can be retained as background, but the local payoff is simpler and stronger: the named divine subject is the one who binds the promise. The promise formula links especially with 48:29.
words.root_gloss_range: worship, devotion, refuge, and derivationally disputed bewilderment; locally the fixed proper name functions as the named subject of the promise

topics.headline: explicit named promiser
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is not left to an implied subject; the named divine subject is placed where the pledge is being certified.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word the nominative subject of the promise verb, and the CRITICAL rows correctly preserve the overt naming as a reader-facing feature.

topics.headline: proper-name and derivation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the proper divine name as more than a generic authority label, while derivational disputes remain background rather than a second local sense.
topics.reason: The local form is a fixed proper name and the V4 bundle has no root guardrail rows for this root; therefore the derivational material survives only as qualified background around the named subject.

topics.headline: misplaced outcome contrast
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The row concerns the later magnitude adjective and the 5:41 reward-punishment contrast, so it adds no distinct reader payoff for the divine-name word itself.
topics.reason: The row is real for the ayah's outcome network but is not locally anchored to this word beyond the general divine-promise setting.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun serving as recipient object and opening the defining clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) receives the promise as its direct object and immediately opens the clause that defines who the recipients are. The promise is therefore not addressed to an unnamed moral abstraction; it is routed to the ones characterized by trust and restorative work. Across the boundary from 5:8, the directly addressed believers become a third-person group described as promise recipients.

topics.headline: defined recipient group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipient word converts the promise into an eligibility frame defined by the following actions.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence supports both roles at once: the word is the object of the promise verb and the head of the relative clause that defines the group.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural perfect trust verb without an overt object in the local frame
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) is the first finite action inside the relative clause. Its plural perfect agreement binds it to the promised group, and the security-root field makes the condition more than bare opinion: it marks an entered trust-state. The local frame has no overt object, so the compression should not be expanded into a specific object of belief unless a later translation layer requires it. The word also waits for the coordinated work verb; trust alone does not close the recipient definition. The familiar audience formula is therefore specialized here by the work-and-restoration clause.
words.root_gloss_range: safety, security, trust, faithfulness, and entering trust; locally the Form IV plural marks an achieved trust-state in the recipient definition

topics.headline: entered trust-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipients are characterized by an achieved trust-state, not merely by a label or abstract belief category.
topics.reason: QAC, valency, and implicit-subject evidence support a Form IV perfect plural verb with no overt object, preserving the trust-state payoff while respecting the local compression.

topics.headline: trust joined to work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar trust formula is not left alone; it is joined to performed restorative work as the promise condition.
topics.reason: The following conjunction and coordinated verb are syntactically licensed, and the contextual evidence confirms the frequent trust-work pairing without inventing a new sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the two relative-clause conditions
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the recipient definition from ending at trust. It coordinates the work verb directly with the trust verb inside the same relative clause, so the promised group is defined by trust plus performed restorative deeds. The particle also participates in the ayah's broader linking cadence: opening connection, internal condition-link, and final reward-link.

topics.headline: condition coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction makes trust and deeds one shared eligibility frame rather than two separable promises.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second verb as conjoined with the trust verb, exactly preserving the CRITICAL coordination claim.

topics.headline: linking cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sound-and-syntax chain that pairs the joined conditions with the joined promised goods.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunctions are visible in the local word sequence and the payoff is structural rather than a separate semantic claim.

words.gloss_range: Form I plural perfect work verb governing the restorative-deeds object
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) supplies the second action in the recipient definition and shares the same plural subject as the trust verb. The root field narrows ordinary doing toward intentional work or accountable labor, and the explicit object that follows tells what kind of work is performed. That makes the later wage noun feel structurally prepared rather than decorative. Within the surah, the trust-work-restoration triad returns in 5:69 and 5:93, while 5:5 gives the inverse warning that work collapses when trust is denied.
